followUps.reason: function the row names that P2 did not return: IOBoard.md@08042b0:244 and V31 (found by R3) place a Schmitt buffer with no transition-rate limit between the debounce and the clock; P2's latch record has a 'clock edge' requirement that names SN74AUP1G17 but returns no function, candidates or placement count for this part. It is a second SN74AUP1G17 placement beside the Q9 buffer (7 placements by 5 boards would not change the gate) and needs its own record.

followUps.function: switched-node freewheel diode (negative clamp of the ESC-side node, V54)
followUps.reason: function the row names that P2 did not return: V54 (owner, 2026-09-28) states that the switched node goes negative until a clamp conducts, and P2's SOA requirements for the onboard MOSFETs and the external module assume 'about 1 V of the freewheel diode on the switched node'. P2's clamp record lists a negative-clamp requirement (above -0.3 V where an INA228 pin sits on it, which none does) but returns no function and no candidate for the diode: it must carry 300 A (onboard) and 600 A (external) for the 0.5 uH discharge (22.5 mJ and 90 mJ), and stand 67.2 V reverse with the switch closed. No entry exists, so the SOA qualification of rank 1 rests on an unselected part.
